script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Saturn is locking into your 10th House of career while Jupiter, your ruling planet, squares Neptune in your 2nd House of money, splitting your ambition from your dreams. Your love life is touching your 7th House, where Neptune dissolves boundaries and makes intimacy feel fated, magnetic, or confusing. If you're partnered, watch for emotional fog and unspoken expectations. If single, you may attract someone who mirrors your deepest longing tonight. In career and money, don't lend your full savings to a vague vision or chase quick funding; your 10th House reputation needs grounded steps. Avoid messy promises, but an unexpected blessing or creative opportunity could land through a trusted connection. Protect your heart and your bank account. This is your cosmic warning and your quiet blessing. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
